test_cases.name: requires_structure_classification
test_cases.input: Why did this prompt work once but fail the next three times?
assertions: Must start with Structure Classification identifying sampling or variance
Must not treat the single success as capability
Must include Intent, Specification, and Gap

test_cases.name: blocks_direct_code
test_cases.input: Write a Python script that scrapes this site and saves to CSV
assertions: Must produce Design and Field Map before any code

test_cases.name: specification_gap_explicit
test_cases.input: Make an agent that is helpful but never hallucinates
assertions: Must explicitly name the Intent-Specification gap
Must classify as specification or mixed
Must propose testable checks rather than vague promises
